test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: ‘Up’ is related to ‘Down’ in the same way as ‘Cold’ is related to ‘________’.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• ‘Up’ is related to ‘Down’ → Up is antonym of Down.

Similarly,

 
• ‘Cold’ is related to ‘________’ → Cold is antonym of Hot.

Hence, '**Hot**' is the correct answer.
